newsitem.title: USA: Cephalon, Chiron seek European marketing.
newsitem.headline: Cephalon, Chiron seek European marketing.

text.p: Cephalon Inc said Wednesday it and Chiron Corp filed a joint marketing authorization application with the European Medicines Evaluation Agency for clearance to market Myotrophin Injection in Europe to treat amyotrophic lateral sclerosis -- also known as ALS, or motor neuron disease.

The application was filed and has been accepted for review under the European Union's centralized procedure, through which a decision on a single marketing authorization is binding on all 15 member states, Cephalon explained.
The member nations include the United Kingdom, Ireland, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Greece and Austria.
The company said Myotrophin is rhIGF-I or mecasermin or recombinant DNA origin.
